Game Overview

Fisherman is a arcade game built around experience the thrill of a relaxing summer as you master the art of fishing. Fisherman demands precision timing and strategic planning to reel in swift, elusive fish. With only three hooks at your disposal, every catch counts, making each throw a thrilling challenge in pursuit of high scores.
